# TRiP

This is where you will find documentation to the R code behind the
**T**ransit **Ri**dership **P**rediction (TRiP) Tool.

## Introduction

The goal of the TRiP Tool is to help small- to medium- sized transit
agencies to predict their future ridership.

## Accessing the App

[Download the PDF Users
Manual](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/pdf/manual.pdf)

[Open Current TRiP
Tool](https://019f7142-d057-c4b5-68a3-3421b30aab9e.share.connect.posit.cloud/)

## Access the App’s Code

Click [here](https://github.com/KamrynMansfield/TRiP) to access the
github repository for the TRiP Tool Shiny App.

The R code below will install the development version of the TRiP R
package from [GitHub](https://github.com/). This is not recommended as
the r package mainly exists to document the Shiny App, but you are
welcome to install it in order to use the functions created for the
Shiny App.

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("KamrynMansfield/TRiP")
```

## File Structure

Explain where to find the shiny app UI and Server codes.

Explain how each R function is it’s only script inside the R folder.

Go to the reference tab to view documentation for each function.

## Shiny App

Details of the coding behind the app.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`check_coefficients()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/check_coefficients.md)
  : Check model coefficient reasonableness
- [`combine_acs_data()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/combine_acs_data.md)
  : Organize Pulled ACS Data
- [`create_final_acs_data()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/create_final_acs_data.md)
  : Prepare acs data for regression model
- [`create_intersecting_tract_percentages()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/create_intersecting_tract_percentages.md)
  : Find tracts that intersect the route buffer
- [`create_regression_model()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/create_regression_model.md)
  : Create regression model to predict bus ridership
- [`find_overlapping_counties()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/find_overlapping_counties.md)
  : Find the counties that overlap the route geometry.
- [`get_crs()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/get_crs.md)
  : Find EPSG code for State Plane CRS
- [`get_gtfs_routes()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/get_gtfs_routes.md)
  : Get transit route geometry
- [`get_tract_geometry()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/get_tract_geometry.md)
  : Get census tract geometry for given counties
- [`make_route_leaflet()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/make_route_leaflet.md)
  : Build the interactive route map
- [`plot_forecast()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/plot_forecast.md)
  : Plot forecasted UPT
- [`plot_forecast_facet()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/plot_forecast_facet.md)
  : Plot forecasted UPT for all routes in a facet wrap
- [`pull_acs_data()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/pull_acs_data.md)
  : Use the county data frame to get needed acs tables
- [`run_app()`](https://kamrynmansfield.github.io/TRiP/reference/run_app.md)
  : Run the Shiny Application
